Why it is shaped this way
Three pillars, all of which follow from deriving rather than declaring:
- Modular composition to tackle logic complexity
- Synchronous and asynchronous validation with type-safe exceptions (inferred from validators and submit handler)
- Support for multiple forms in the same state with automatic scoping
All of this is possible because the logic is entirely derived from the state.
